ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Care PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

2. C — Ice melting to water

3. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

4. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

5. D — 100 °C

6. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

8. D — Glucose and oxygen

9. A — newton (N)

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.

11. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

12. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dressing ENVIRONMENT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of PRACTICES; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Care PRACTICES; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
